svg.title: HAGIA SOPHIA — LONGITUDINAL PENDENTIVE & HALF-DOME SECTION
svg.desc: East-west longitudinal section and key plan of Hagia Sophia showing the 55.6 m 40-ribbed central dome on spherical pendentives braced by eastern and western half-domes.
